title: 第15章 苏家小姐通知与刺杀第16章 族比将至父子相谈
content_zh:
看着面前熟悉的面容，苏若晴先是愣了一下，随即抱着叶无尘痛哭了起来。
“尘哥哥，对不起，真的...对不起。”
少女不停地在道歉，在她看来，苏家对尘哥哥做了这么过分的事情。
而自己作为苏家的二小姐，她的尘哥哥肯定已经恨透她了。
可如今，在自己陷入危险的时候，对方又在自己最需要的时候出现了。
“你没必要道歉，我也从未怪过你。”
看到少女的反应，叶无尘已经知道，眼前的少女并没有变。
苏家与叶家的决裂，最痛苦的不是他这个当事人，反而是这个心思最为单纯的少女。
她是苏府的二小姐，同样也是叶无尘的妹妹。
自从得知苏家与叶家决裂之后，苏若晴曾不止一次提出想去叶家看看叶无尘。
可每次都被苏山河拒绝了，甚至还被自己父亲软禁了起来。
待少女情绪稳定下来，叶无尘开口朝苏若晴问道：“你又不习武，怎么会独自跑来此地？”
听闻此话，少女这才想起自己前来的目的。
于是将发生在苏府中的对话一五一十告诉了叶无尘。
听完苏若晴的叙述之后，叶无尘惨白眼眸中闪过一抹幽光，他没想到苏山河竟然会派人来追杀自己。
他又看向苏若晴，眼神中的淡漠消散了一部分。
苏若晴为了告诉他这个消息，独自一人长途跋涉。
明知自己毫无修为还毅然而然的踏入了这片妖兽横行的天断山中。
这份心意，叶无尘已然记在心中。
“尘哥哥，咱们快跑吧，只要杀手找不到我们，我们便安全了。”

苏若晴焦急的开口道。
而此时，叶无尘的眸光却变得淡漠了起来。
“没必要了。”
话音落下，叶无尘手中浮现短刀，随即他猛地朝树林中一个方向掷了出去。
而此时，一棵枝叶茂密的大树上，一名男子瞳孔微颤，身形猛的朝一旁躲闪开来。
叶夕月见状，脚尖一踏地面，身形迅速朝男子冲去。
叶夕月的战斗技巧极为不俗，如今又占着先出手的优势，此时可谓是占尽了上风。
“小心！”
就在此时，叶无尘低喝一声。
叶夕月闻言，当即朝一旁闪去。
与此同时，她之前站立的地方，一道灵力所化的掌印袭来。
“通窍境。”
content_en:
Seeing the familiar face in front of her, Su Ruoqing was stunned for a moment, then hugged Ye Wuchen and cried bitterly.
"Brother Chen, I'm sorry, I'm really...sorry."
The girl kept apologizing. In her opinion, the Su family had done such an excessive thing to Brother Chen.
As the second young lady of the Su family, her brother Chen must have hated her.
But now, when he was in danger, the other party appeared when he needed it most.
"You don't need to apologize, and I never blamed you."
Seeing the girl's reaction, Ye Wuchen already knew that the girl in front of him had not changed.
The most painful thing about the break between the Su family and the Ye family was not him as the person involved, but the girl with the most innocent mind.
She is the second young lady of Su Mansion and Ye Wuchen's younger sister.
Ever since she learned that the Su family had broken up with the Ye family, Su Ruoqing had proposed more than once that she wanted to go to the Ye family to visit Ye Wuchen.
But he was rejected by Su Shanhe every time, and was even put under house arrest by his father.
After the girl's mood stabilized, Ye Wuchen asked Su Ruoqing: "You don't practice martial arts, how come you came here alone?"
After hearing this, the girl remembered the purpose of her coming.
So he told Ye Wuchen everything about the conversation that took place in Su's house.
After listening to Su Ruoqing's narration, a faint light flashed in Ye Wuchen's pale eyes. He did not expect that Su Shanhe would send people to hunt him down.
He looked at Su Ruoqing again, part of the indifference in his eyes dissipated.
In order to tell him the news, Su Ruoqing traveled a long distance alone.
Knowing that he had no cultivation, he still resolutely stepped into Tianduan Mountain where monsters were rampant.
Ye Wuchen has already remembered this intention in his heart.
"Brother Chen, let's run. As long as the killer can't find us, we will be safe."
Su Ruoqing said anxiously.
But at this time, Ye Wuchen's eyes became indifferent.
"That's not necessary."
After the words fell, a short knife appeared in Ye Wuchen's hand, and then he threw it in a direction in the woods.
At this time, on a large tree with dense leaves, a man's pupils trembled slightly, and his figure suddenly dodged to the side.
Seeing this, Ye Xiyue stepped on the ground with her toes and rushed towards the man quickly.
Ye Xiyue's fighting skills are extremely good, and now she has the advantage of striking first. It can be said that she has the upper hand at this time.
"Be careful!"
At this moment, Ye Wuchen let out a low drink.
Hearing this, Ye Xiyue immediately stepped aside.
At the same time, where she was standing before, a palm print transformed by spiritual power struck.
"Tongqiao Realm."
